KANIHIRO Course
The finest course at Kanihiro, showcasing live snow crab in its entirety. Thoughtfully curated as an omakase based on the day’s condition, each dish—from sashimi and grilling to hot pot—draws out the crab’s full depth of flavor. A luxurious experience that uses a whole crab, perfect for a truly special occasion.
¥60,000Svc excl. / tax incl.

Pine Course
A luxurious full-course experience featuring live snow crab alongside premium wagyu. From sashimi to grilled, hot pot, and crab miso shell dishes, each preparation highlights the full depth of the crab’s flavor. Complemented by a rich wagyu steak course, this refined menu is ideal for special occasions and memorable dining.
¥45,000Svc excl. / tax incl.

Bamboo Course
Our most popular course featuring live snow crab. From sashimi and grilled crab to hot pot, crab miso shell dishes, and clay pot rice, this nine-course menu showcases the full range of the crab’s flavor. Thoughtfully paired with seasonal ingredients, it offers a well-balanced and satisfying dining experience.
¥33,000Svc excl. / tax incl.
